import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int maxn = 8;
    static final int SZ = 1048576 + 5;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int inc(int a, int b) {
        return (a + b >= MOD) ? (a + b - MOD) : (a + b);
    }

    static int dec(int a, int b) {
        return (a >= b) ? (a - b) : (a + MOD - b);
    }

    static int mul(int a, int b) {
        return (int) ((long) a * b % MOD);
    }

    static void updata(int[] x, int y) {
        x[0] = inc(x[0], y);
    }

    static int power(int x, int k) {
        int tmp = 1;
        while (k > 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) {
                tmp = mul(tmp, x);
            }
            x = mul(x, x);
            k >>= 1;
        }
        return tmp;
    }

    static int n;
    static int[][] a = new int[maxn][maxn];
    static int inv100;
    static int[][] g = new int[maxn][maxn];
    static int[] p = new int[SZ];
    static int[][][] num = new int[7][7][7];
    static int all;
    static int Ans;

    static boolean check(int x, int y, int z) {
        int[] pos = {0, 1, 2, 3};
        int[] lis = {0, x, y, z};
        do {
            boolean flag = true;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
                if (g[pos[i]][lis[i]] == 0) {
                    flag = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (flag) return true;
        } while (nextPermutation(pos, 1, 3));
        return false;
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] arr, int start, int end) {
        int i = end;
        while (i > start && arr[i - 1] >= arr[i]) i--;
        if (i <= start) return false;
        int j = end;
        while (arr[j] <= arr[i - 1]) j--;
        swap(arr, i - 1, j);
        reverse(arr, i, end);
        return true;
    }

    static void swap(int[] arr, int i, int j) {
        int tmp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = tmp;
    }

    static void reverse(int[] arr, int start, int end) {
        while (start < end) {
            swap(arr, start, end);
            start++;
            end--;
        }
    }

    static void dfs1(int now, int x, int y) {
        boolean[] used = new boolean[7];
        if (now == 0) return;
        if (now == 0 && x == 4 && y == 1) {
            int xxx = 0;
            xxx++;
        }
        if (x == 4) {
            Arrays.fill(used, true);
            int sta = 0;
            if (now != 0) {
                int xxx = 0;
                xxx++;
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (check(i, j, k)) {
                            int X = -1, Y = -1, Z = -1;
                            used[i] = used[j] = used[k] = false;
                            for (int l = 1; l <= 6; l++) {
                                if (!used[l]) continue;
                                if (X == -1) X = l;
                                else if (Y == -1) Y = l;
                                else Z = l;
                            }
                            used[i] = used[j] = used[k] = true;
                            if (Z == -1) continue;
                            sta |= num[X][Y][Z];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            int[] pRef = {0};
            updata(pRef, now);
            p[sta] = inc(p[sta], now);
            return;
        }
        g[x][y] = 1;
        int nxt = mul(now, a[x][y]);
        if (y == 6) {
            dfs1(nxt, x + 1, 1);
        } else {
            dfs1(nxt, x, y + 1);
        }
        g[x][y] = 0;
        nxt = mul(now, dec(1, a[x][y]));
        if (y == 6) {
            dfs1(nxt, x + 1, 1);
        } else {
            dfs1(nxt, x, y + 1);
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(int now, int x, int y) {
        if (now == 0) return;
        if (x == 7) {
            int sta = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (check(i, j, k)) {
                            sta |= num[i][j][k];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            int[] pRef = {0};
            updata(pRef, mul(now, p[all ^ sta]));
            return;
        }
        g[x - 3][y] = 1;
        int nxt = mul(now, a[x][y]);
        if (y == 6) {
            dfs2(nxt, x + 1, 1);
        } else {
            dfs2(nxt, x, y + 1);
        }
        g[x - 3][y] = 0;
        nxt = mul(now, dec(1, a[x][y]));
        if (y == 6) {
            dfs2(nxt, x + 1, 1);
        } else {
            dfs2(nxt, x, y + 1);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        inv100 = power(100, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = mul(sc.nextInt(), inv100);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n + 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            a[i][i] = 1;
        }
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                    num[i][j][k] = 1 << cnt;
                    cnt++;
                }
            }
        }
        all = (1 << cnt) - 1;
        dfs1(1, 1, 1);
        for (int j = 0; j < cnt; j++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << cnt); i++) {
                if ((i & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                    updata(p, p[i ^ (1 << j)]);
                }
            }
        }
        Ans = 0;
        dfs2(1, 4, 1);
        Ans = dec(1, Ans);
        System.out.println(Ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
